SERVICES
On July 1, 2024, Novi’s Senior Transportation Service will be transitioned to
People’s Express (PEX).
PEX has been operating curb-to-curb transportation services for over 30 years
and is for everyone. All Novi residents can take advantage - regardless of
age, ability, or income. For anything from doctor visits, rides to and from
the library, grocery shopping, or even to work, residents 14 and older
877.214.6073
can schedule rides with PEX. Residents younger than 14 must
be accompanied by a guardian.
